description:
[receipt] A SIGNED snapshot: the wrapped endpoint's JSON plus an attestation (SHA-256 of the
    canonical JSON, server time, Ed25519 signature, key id). Anyone can verify it offline with
    the public key at /api/v1/attest/key, so an agent acting for someone else can prove what the
    exchanges reported when it decided. Free snapshots and conclusions only (no metered history).
    It certifies what LiquidVision served, not that the exchange was right. Priced: $0.05 per call (x402),
    10 prepaid credits, or a key's daily quota; the public key at /attest/key is free.

params.description: Query string for the wrapped path, e.g. 'q=why+did+BTC+drop&coin=BTC' or 'symbol=BTC&side=long&entry=74000&leverage=20'.
params.title: Params

path.description: API path under /api/v1 to wrap, e.g. /funding, /oi, /liquidations, /oiboard/BTCUSDT, /liqmap/BTCUSDT, /answer, /position/check.
path.title: Path

name: attest_snapshot
